name: HappyToHelp

spine.record: a customer request with bounded delegation and verified evidence

description: An owner-operated support desk for accountable agent-delegated resolution across connected workspaces.
scope: One installation and owner, multiple scoped workspace connections.

capabilities.description: Scoped credentials, bounded modes, resumable claims, operator questions, verified evidence and durable reply approval.

nonGoals: Inbound email ingestion or knowledge base

externals.why: Owner-controlled Worker runtime and D1 persistence.
Internet email delivery requires a configured sender.

env.name: APP_ORIGIN
env.why: Pins the canonical browser request origin.

env.name: H2H_DEPLOY_MODE
env.why: Explicit local or remote target when the Base CLI invokes setup/deploy without command arguments.

deploy.notes: The document contains no private data until authenticated API reads. Operator APIs require session and same-origin mutations. Agent APIs require scoped bearer credentials.

limits.status: functional limits enforced; capacity not load tested

accessibility.status: Target; keyboard and responsive core journey verification in progress, no full audit claim.

operatingCost.notes: Owner pays Cloudflare runtime/storage, agent tools and optional SendGrid usage.
